exact_domain: All real 0<h<=1, Euclidean vertices (-1,0),(1,0),(0,h), and their three side midpoints; real scalar linear Lipschitz extensions modulo constants.
integrity_note: The analytic proof checks all pair types and gives explicit lower witnesses for the unrestricted operator. Finite high-precision tests support but do not replace the proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No theorem for acute isosceles or scalene triangles, full triangular interiors, or global mesh assemblies. No separate per-target-space optimality assertion for Banach-valued functions. Residual possibility of equivalent obscure finite-metric interpolation literature.
title: Sharp positive Lipschitz interpolation at the three midpoints of an obtuse isosceles triangle
